title: Incolor SSR — The Chinese Hyperbike Nobody's Talking About

takeaways.text: States a 38 mm tire limit, which conflicts with the 36 mm (1×) / 32 mm (2×) figures given by a retailer and another reviewer; he did not test-fit.

The bayonet front end uses small, identical upper and lower bearings and a steering-limit screw that should be secured with threadlocker; 3D-printed 5 mm spacers and a cover hide the routing, and the included manual was in Chinese only.
The 58 cm frame in Mercury (said to be the heaviest paint) weighed 1.01 kg alone; with fork, cockpit, titanium hardware, computer mount and UDH hanger it weighed 1.91 kg.
He waited about four months for the frame from Panda Podium and warns of long lead times; he put the retail price at about US$4,000 in June 2026.

disclosure: The presenter says he bought the 58 cm frameset with his own money from Panda Podium and is not sponsored by Incolor.
summary: Owner's first look at a self-bought 58 cm Incolor SSR frameset before building it, with weigh-ins and a teardown of the bayonet front end.
